apps.name: Base
apps.subtitle: Notes, vault, and agents on iPhone and iPad.
apps.localizedDescription: Base puts handwritten notes, your Markdown vault, and your agent threads in one app. Pair it with a Base or Code server to use it.

versions.localizedDescription: Base is now one app for handwritten notes, your Markdown vault, and your agent threads. It replaces the earlier Base app in place. After updating, add an environment to pair it with a Base or Code server.

Notes: the pen that follows pressure draws its line in its real thickness from the first touch, so nothing changes when the Pencil lifts. The strokes go to the page at the next pause in the writing instead of at every lift, which keeps long notes smooth. Undo and redo are steadier: an undone stroke no longer comes back with the next one drawn.

Notes: the toolbox works like Notability's (style tray with quick colours, the 64-slot Colors popover, thickness presets, Partial/Whole eraser, Navigate), and the pen's line now follows Pencil pressure the way Notability's does. Notes also syncs every 20 seconds while open.

Base 0.4.5. Notes fixes: ink written just before leaving the app is saved, fast writing reaches autosave within a second, and Back waits for the save and says when it fails. A page whose ink cannot be loaded is read-only instead of being overwritten, and repeated partial erases are saved. Imported notes keep Notability recognized text; handwriting added in Base is appended. Pencil double-tap works again and the double squeeze is detected more reliably. Template Settings: spacing starts at 12 pt and no longer resizes pages by accident. Long notes stutter less after each stroke and import is about twice as fast. Sync and Hand Off are protected against overwrites, stale deletions and shell targets.

Base 0.4.4: pinch below page width without snapping back. Hold Apple Pencil Pro squeeze to erase and release to restore your tool; two quick squeezes toggle it persistently. More > Template Settings previews paper, ruling, spacing, colour, size and orientation before Apply, with named My Templates and a per-page option. A resize cannot crop existing ink or pictures. Coloured notes require an updated daemon to sync.
Base 0.4.3. Fixes a crash that could close the app a few seconds after launch: a live connection to a host that was restarted while it was still opening could abort the app.

Base 0.4.2. Notes: import a Notability note with every stroke as real ink, its shapes, photos, recognized text, page size and ruling (library Import action, or put the .nbn folder into Documents/Notability Import). The note screen is rebuilt after Notability: its own toolbox with pen, pencil, highlighter, eraser, text, select, add, dictate and finger drawing, per-tool colours, thickness and favourites, all pages in one scrolling document, a page manager, and dark paper in dark mode. PDFs under the ink are not imported yet.

Base 0.4.1. Notes sync and handoff are offered only on hosts running Base 0.4 or later, and the app says so in plain words when no connected host is. Fixes the "Method Not Allowed" shown when a note was handed to an older host.

Base 0.4.0. Notes: handwritten and typed notes on iPad, synced to a Base daemon and handed to an agent session. Spoken replies: a reply is read aloud when its message was dictated, through Zonos on hosts that have it and with the device voice elsewhere. Backing-store status in Settings. Notes sync, handoff and Zonos need a 0.4 daemon; with an older daemon notes stay on the device.

Base 0.3.74 app update for macOS and iOS. Historical pre-input refusals retain their original evidence without blocking a genuinely new explicit send after exact separate-delivery confirmation. Uncertain requests still prevent duplicate submission, and acknowledgement IDs are matched byte-for-byte. Drafts, histories and receipt identities are preserved. This app/mobile release is independent of the already published 0.3.74 runtime and does not restart or replace providers. New durable-lifetime and pinned-runner recovery work is not included or claimed activated. Automatic update checks are enabled; automatic downloads and installs remain disabled.

Preserves pending input and uncertain receipts without replay. Pending messages remain italic until context acknowledgement, with delivery details available only on demand. Includes cross-client submission fixes, faster OMP journal receipt scans, and restored iOS private-tailnet routing while preserving native authorization and exact receipt validation.

Ownership graphs now show same-parent siblings alongside the selected chat and each visible ancestor level, including hidden and offline sessions across hosts. Only the selected chat's descendant subtree expands. On macOS, opening the graph or changing focus centers the selected card, while fleet refreshes preserve manual panning. Hidden-session navigation remains transient and window-local.
Add the opt-in Fn/Globe dictation control, keep graph-opened hidden chats transient in the sidebar, and recognize Astra OMP sessions.
Restores graph state and ancestry, queued-message italics, Command-G graph toggling and highlight, programmable Tab insertion, and complete GPU power disclosure.
Keeps hidden owned sessions and their edges visible in the ownership graph while ordinary session navigation stays filtered.
Recovers Anthropic usage from healthy fleet peers and compacts the expanded 280-point sidebar so every GPU and token status fits.
Stabilizes OMP working-state italics across redraws, fixes macOS ownership-graph arrows, assigns all GPC chats to HATT, and dismisses the iPhone/iPad keyboard before opening the graph.
Make iPad connection recovery independent of Tailscale path callbacks: retry failed routes on foreground activation, use fresh health and SSE sessions, and cap visible retry backoff at eight seconds.
Prevent stale /btw overlays from reappearing after daemon restarts. Add base create with automatic ownership, automatic sidebar hiding, rollback safety, and owner data in list output.
Preserve Hatt activity timestamps, keep Base hosts distinct by raw daemon identity, repair stale iPhone fleet seeds, and make macOS daemon installation machine-aware.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow Base to use your camera to scan pairing QR codes and add photos to your notes.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Allow Base to access your Face ID biometric data.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Allow Base to connect to Base servers on your local network or tailnet.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Base to use your microphone for voice input.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow Base to save images to your photo library.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow Base to add pictures from your photo library to your notes.

apps.name: Riad
apps.subtitle: Home server, private dictation, and briefing.
apps.localizedDescription: Riad is the native client for the mini's private dashboard, service controls, news and morning briefing, and Scribe dictation through the Mac mini's local WhisperKit model.

versions.localizedDescription: Make integrated Scribe visible in persistent navigation, deep-link App Shortcuts directly into recording, stop dashboard setup from blocking dictation, and omit the SideStore-incompatible widget extension.
Restores private Scribe connectivity through the Base tailnet proxy and adds a one-tap Control Center dictation control on iOS 18 and later.
Folds Scribe into Riad: private foreground dictation through the Mac mini, Dictate with Riad shortcut activation, explicit Copy and Share, and one combined SideStore install.
Winds in Marina: two-column medium, direction column dropped for space.
Winds in Marina: today's forecast from 8am and the next three days (large widget).
Winds in Marina widget: mph, altitude rows, cleaner layout.
Winds in Marina: mph, altitude rows, cleaner layout.
Show the installed build in connection settings; KOAR winds widget.
KOAR winds-aloft widget: surface, 925, 850, 700 hPa from GFS, home screen and Lock Screen families.
Tighter oasis icon: palm cluster centered.
Oasis app icon from the real photograph, replacing the glass glyph.
First Riad release: Base-style minimal UI, briefing, news digests, service controls, and this update channel.

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Riad records voice for its Scribe page, then sends the recording over your private Tailscale network to your Mac mini for local transcription.

apps.name: Code
apps.subtitle: Work with your coding agents on iPhone and iPad.
apps.localizedDescription: Pair Code with your own Code server to open projects, follow agent threads, and send messages from your phone or tablet.

versions.localizedDescription: Fixes the Home Screen icon showing only a magnified patch of the moon.
First Code release on Riad Apps. The native client connects to your existing Code environment.

privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Allow Code to access your Face ID biometric data.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Allow Code to connect to Code servers on your local network or tailnet.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Code to use your microphone for voice input.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow Code to save images to your photo library.
